title: This Illinois Ghost Tour Was Just Named One of America's Best
excerpt: Illinois is home to one of America's 10 best ghost tours, according to a new ranking based on ratings, five-star reviews and total reviews.
content:
You don't have to travel all the way to Salem or Savannah to take one of America's best ghost tours. Apparently, we've got one right here in Illinois.

A new study ranked America's best ghost tours based on reviews from people who've actually taken them.

READ MORE: Illinois Hotel One of Most Terrifyingly Haunted Spots in America

One of America's Best Ghost Tours Is in Illinois

I'm not a walking tour aficionado, but I took one in Savannah, and my two-word review would be "it's fine."

Anyway, they looked at average ratings, the percentage of five-star reviews, and the number of reviews before giving each tour something called a "Ghost Experience Score."

Chicago Ghost Tour Ranks Among the Top 10 in America

The History and Hauntings of Salem Guided Walking Tour in Salem, Massachusetts was top-ranked, but Illinois' Haunted Chicago Crime, Ghosts and Capone Walking Tour ranked 8th.

It was the only ghost tour in the top 10 originating in Illinois and the only one located in the Midwest.

READ MORE: Ghost Tours Across Illinois Blend Paranormal Stories & History

What Makes a Ghost Tour One of America's Best?

Keep in mind, this isn't based on how many ghosts or how haunted each tour is; it's only on what visitors enjoyed the most.

Then again, if you actually see a ghost on the tour, I feel like that's an automatic five stars.
